question: What physical liberation and spiritual companionship result from this sustained practice?
premises: The practitioner becomes freed from all diseases.
The practitioner gains association with yogis.
inference: Through this practice one becomes free from all diseases and attains union with yogis.
uncertainties: saha+melakam may mean meeting, companionship, or mystical union.
plain_english: Freed from all diseases, one attains union with the yogis.
